Set \(a - \frac{a}{2}t = at\). Dividing by \(a>0\):

\[
1-\frac{t}{2}=t \implies t=\frac{2}{3}
\]

So

\[
F=\left(\frac{2a}{3},\frac{2a}{3}\right)
\]

Using shoelace for quadrilateral \(AFED\):

\[
[AFED]=\frac12\left|\frac{2a^2}{3}+\frac{a^2}{2}-\frac{a^2}{3}\right|
=\frac{5a^2}{12}
\]

Given \([AFED]=45\):

\[
\frac{5a^2}{12}=45 \implies a^2=108
\]

Thus the area of square \(ABCD\) is

\[
\boxed{108}
\]
